papers.title: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training
papers.what: Uses chess as a controlled testbed to separate pretraining from RL, finding that pretraining loss predicts post-RL reasoning performance and that pretraining tokens set the slope of the RL reward curve.

papers.title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
papers.what: A healthcare language model trained through a human-gated self-evolution loop that rewrites its own data mixture from observed benchmark failures, covering consultation, clinical reasoning, diagnosis, and EHR tool use without regressing one skill for another.
papers.builds_on: Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023); CounselBench (Li 2025); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025)

papers.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
papers.what: Distills the delta signal (the difference between a reasoning-tuned teacher and its base model) instead of the full teacher distribution, transferring reasoning ability more directly and beating standard on-policy distillation across math, science, and code.

papers.title: S1-Omni: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Scientific Understanding, Prediction, and Generation
papers.what: Maps heterogeneous scientific objects (structures, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, images) plus instructions into one shared space with domain-native decoders, spanning 200 scientific tasks and reportedly beating GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on most of 60+ benchmarks.
